alfonso-1576-04-14.summary: The duke tells his agent how to handle an unnamed man who fears stricter proceedings: he was never in Este pay, Ferrara cannot shelter him, and he is to get fifty scudi. A second hand turns to oils and almonds, a Roman complaint and the prisoners of Rovigo.

system: Simple substitution of Italian in Latin letter forms: 20 signs for the 20 letters, five nulls (x, y, k, & and 3), and the digit 7 for itself. No word division and no code groups. The null x often stands between identical signs.
